ἐπωβελία , ἡ, ʽὀβελόσ̓
A.fine of an obol in the drachma, i.e. one-sixth of the sum at which the damages were laid, paid as compensation to the defendant by the plaintiff in case the latter failed to gain one-fifth of the votes, τὴν ἐ. ὀφλεῖν, τῆς ἐ. κινδυνεύειν,
D. 27.67 , 31.14 .
2. added payment of one-sixth per mensem, as a penalty for failure to discharge debts, Pl. Lg. 921d .
3. dub. sens. in
PCair.Zen. 15r . 44
(iii B. C.).
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
